source.title: How polysemantic can one neuron be? Investigating features in TinyStories.

record.tranche_reason: The study examines neuron-feature relationships with SAE decoder directions, a different measure from counting interpretable neuron poles.
record.gate_note: The reported neuron-feature alignment and qualitative interpretability findings bear on V1's neuron-polysemanticity question, but do not measure the share of neuron poles with one or two jobs. The SAE reconstruction-loss and MLP zero-ablation-loss comparisons, feature-frequency plots, and number of active features per token do not measure a claim version and are not rows.
record.test_reason: The post takes neuron polysemanticity as a premise and cites the cat-and-car example. It only measures how SAE decoder directions spread over MLP neurons and how interpretable selected SAE features look. It never inspects any neuron's own activating examples or counts the jobs of neuron poles, so its results do not bear on V1–V7.
record.authors_conclusion: Mostly right. The author finds that neuron 703 is the most-aligned neuron for 475 SAE features. The easiest-to-label features, chosen by largest activation, are not mostly aligned with any neuron. Features pointing more toward neuron 703 were qualitatively harder to interpret. The author poses open questions rather than conclusions, and never assesses neuron 703's own activations.
record.recipe_differences: Uses pretrained SAEs to measure feature-direction power across MLP neurons and qualitatively inspect selected features; it does not audit neuron poles by assigning them semantic jobs.
record.method_sensitivity: Feature selection differed: features selected by largest activation were easier to label, while features selected for strong alignment with neuron 703 were harder to interpret.

fits_no_version.finding: In TinyStories-2L-33M layer-1 MLP, neuron 703 is the largest-power direction for 475 of 32768 SAE features. Most other neurons are the top direction for only a handful of features. Features with much power on neuron 703 were qualitatively harder to interpret.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: SAE feature directions concentrate unevenly on MLP neurons: a few neurons are the dominant basis direction for hundreds of SAE features.

fits_no_version.finding: The most easily labelled SAE features (chosen by largest activation) are spread across many neurons, with little power in any single neuron.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Interpretable SAE features in small LMs are generally not neuron-aligned.

record.problems: The study examines a 33M-parameter, 2-layer model and inspects only selected features; the author says tens of thousands of features were not explored. Interpretability judgments are qualitative, and the study does not test explanations on held-out activations or estimate the fraction of neuron poles with particular numbers of jobs.

untested.parts: Share of neuron poles with one, two or unexplained jobs. No neuron's activations are inspected, and the model is TinyStories-2L-33M, not Qwen3-32B.
InceptionV1 cat-and-car reinterpretation (only cited as an example of polysemanticity).
Architecture, regularization and tool effects on interpretable-neuron share.

record.verdict_notes: The reader's 'tests/T2' guess is rejected. 'Polysemantic' here describes SAE feature directions spread across neurons, plus an assumed premise about neurons. It is not a measured share of neuron jobs. Exploratory LessWrong post: one SAE pair, qualitative labels, no controls.

versions.untested_parts: Does not estimate the share of neuron poles with one main job, two related jobs, or no understood job; uses a TinyStories model rather than Qwen3-32B.
Other models, dense and mixture-of-experts models, and scaling to larger models.
The InceptionV1 cat-and-car example and recursive generalization.
Architecture, regularization, tool quality, and interpretability rates in vision models.
Attribution graphs, behavioural explanations, and reconstruction error.
Whether explanations predict firing on examples they were not written from.
Automated scoring of explanations by simulating activations on new text.

rows.subject: TinyStories-2Layers-33M
rows.operation_detail: Counted SAE feature vectors for which each neuron had the greatest share of vector power.
rows.measure: Number of feature vectors for which a neuron was the most-aligned neuron by power
rows.value: Neuron 703 was the most-aligned neuron for 475 features.
rows.note: This is a count of SAE feature directions aligned most strongly with one neuron, not a count of distinct semantic jobs or a share of neuron poles.
rows.check: This counts SAE features whose largest decoder weight falls on neuron 703 (475). That measures SAE feature geometry, not how many semantic jobs the neuron's activation poles have. It does not measure V1's construct.

rows.subject: TinyStories-2Layers-33M
rows.operation_detail: Qualitatively examined features with the largest activations and their alignment with neuron 703.

conditions.value: About 100 features with the largest activations

rows.measure: Qualitative feature interpretability and neuron alignment
rows.value: The features were described as very polysemantic; neuron 703 did not contain much of their direction-vector power.
rows.note: Qualitative assessment; it does not determine how many jobs a neuron pole has.
rows.check: This is a qualitative judgement of SAE feature interpretability, not neuron interpretability. The text says these features were 'very polysemantic' in neuron space, meaning spread across neurons, not that neurons have many jobs.

rows.subject: TinyStories-2Layers-33M
rows.operation_detail: Qualitatively examined features selected for strong alignment with neuron 703.

conditions.value: 50 features most strongly pointing in the direction of neuron 703

rows.value: The features were harder to interpret than the features selected by largest activations.
rows.note: The author reports a qualitative comparison, not a count of jobs per neuron pole.
rows.check: This compares SAE features selected by their alignment with neuron 703. The neuron itself was never examined, so the row bears on no version.

source_check.scope: Only the listed rows, labels and statements were checked; presence is not whole-study approval.
